Good Health.meaning: normal fetal brain plane, routine screening

severity_labels_caveat: The COCO source carries a single label, 'abnormal', and no severity field. The Med/Bad boundary is applied by SEVERITY_MAP in Tools/organize_maternal_data.py from the pathology name parsed out of each filename. It is a clinical convention, not a radiologist's reading of these images. 'Good Health' comes from a different dataset than the other two classes - see Tests/dataset_integrity_test.py for how much accuracy that alone can buy.

pipeline.rationale: identical for every class, so source format, resolution, scanner overlay and global brightness cannot carry the label
